{{Top|leg}}
An '''aerie''' was a traditional [[Tree/Legends|tree house]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bovo Yagen (planet)|Bovo Yagen]]. The native [[Bovorian]]s preferred to live in aeries, although many moved to live on the ground when [[Human/Legends|Humans]] arrived on the planet.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
